Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent hallucinated the answer based on incorrect search result snippets. The search results actually displayed "Robert Seger" as the artist name, but the snippets explicitly stated "Robert Clark Seger" (his full birth name) and referred to him as "Bob Seger" (his actual famous stage name). The WebSurfer incorrectly interpreted the text "Robert Seger" (which was part of the band name "Robert Seger and the Last Heard" or a variation in the snippet) as his primary stage name, failing to recognize that his well-known stage name is simply "Bob Seger". The search results themselves contained the correct information ("Bob Seger"), but the agent failed to extract it correctly and instead synthesized a false conclusion that his stage name is "Robert Seger".
